# Publish Configuration for `zikzak_json`

<!-- Auto-generated by publish-manager skill on 2026-10-02. Edit if the workflow changes. -->

## Package Manager

- **Type**: `pub.dev`
- **Packages**: exactly one — `zikzak_json` at the repo root. No monorepo, no
  `packages/` directory, no path dependencies.
- **Public packages**: `zikzak_json`
- **Private packages**: none

Runtime dependencies are all public: `json5_plus`, `json_path_plus`,
`simdjson_dart`. Note that `json_path_plus` is **re-exported** from
`lib/zikzak_json.dart`, which makes its public API part of ours — its breaking
changes are our breaking changes and must be called out in `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Scripts

There are none. This project has no `scripts/` directory and no `Makefile`;
the release is driven entirely by `dart pub`. The sequence that worked for
0.3.0:

- **Pre-publish**: none. Verify the gate instead — all three must pass:
  ```
  dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test
  dart analyze
  dart test
  ```
- **Publish**: `dart pub publish --force` from the repo root. `--force` skips
  the "uncommitted changes" prompt, so only use it after committing.
- **Post-publish**: none.

## Workflow

1. Update `CHANGELOG.md` — merge any pending entry for the version being
   released into one section. An unreleased version may already have a heading
   on `master` (0.3.0 did); fold into it rather than adding a second.
2. Run the three verification commands above.
3. `dart pub publish --dry-run` — must report `0 warnings`.
4. Commit: `chore: prepare for publishing version <version>`
5. `dart pub publish --force`
6. `git push origin master`
7. `git tag v<version> && git push origin v<version>`

## Conventions

- **Version lives only in `pubspec.yaml`.** No version constant in Dart source.
- **Tags are `v`-prefixed**: `v0.2.0`, `v0.2.1`, `v0.2.2`, `v0.3.0`. (0.2.3 was
  published to pub.dev but never tagged — pre-existing gap, left alone.)
- **Commits are conventional commits**, and PRs are merged into `master` with
  merge commits (`Merge pull request #N from arrrrny/<branch>`). Release commits
  go straight to `master`.
- **`pubspec.lock` is gitignored** — correct for a library package, so there is
  nothing to commit from a `pub get`.
- Keep `dart format` clean. It is not enforced by CI here, but the repo is
  formatted and an unformatted line can trip `curly_braces_in_flow_control_structures`
  under `lints 6`. If formatting reflows a long `if`, add the braces rather than
  reverting the format.

## Gotchas

- **`HTTPS_PROXY` breaks `dart pub`.** With the proxy exported in the shell,
  `dart pub get` and `dart pub publish` fail immediately with
  `Invalid proxy configuration PROXY proxy:<token>@proxy-node.zuzu.dev`.
  Prefix pub commands with `unset HTTPS_PROXY NO_PROXY` (and `http_proxy` /
  `https_proxy` if set). Pub resolves and uploads fine without the proxy.
- **`dart pub publish` is slow to appear.** pub.dev reports
  "it may take up-to 10 minutes before the new version is available"; the API
  reflects it in well under that.
- **Bumping `lints` can surface new diagnostics** in previously clean code — the
  3.0.0 → 6.1.0 jump flagged `unnecessary_library_name`. Always re-run
  `dart analyze` after a dev-dependency bump.
- When testing engine-specific paths, remember a fixture must be valid in *both*
  grammars: JSON5 does not allow unquoted keys containing `/`, `.`, `*`, spaces
  or `$`. Quote those keys in the JSON5 twin of a test document.
- `dart analyze` may need a warm `.dart_tool` after a dependency change; the
  first run compiles native build hooks and can exceed a short command timeout.
